items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: I'm the one that introduced them...

ctx.x: Leslie Uggams, I met her. She may not remember me but I met her. She was dancing at that club downtown... That's where Louis Armstrong first met Lucille. Jay, you should know that.
I'm the one that introduced them...
It was the Cotton Club in those days and then it became the Latin Quarter.
